how.title: Jak to działa
how.step1Text: Opisz swoją firmę, godziny otwarcia i najczęstsze pytania klientów.
how.step2Text: Otrzymasz lokalny numer telefonu lub przekierujesz połączenia z dotychczasowego.
how.step3Text: Każda rozmowa jest nagrywana, a podsumowanie trafia do Ciebie e-mailem lub SMS-em.

security.title: We treat your data responsibly
security.i1Text: The database runs on servers in the European Union. We do not pass data to third parties for their own purposes.
security.i2Text: All communication with the app uses an encrypted connection (HTTPS/TLS). Only you and your team can see call recordings.
security.i3Text: You can delete an agent together with its entire call history and release phone numbers right in the app.

callBehavior.title: Incoming call behavior
callBehavior.ringsHint: The setting is saved but does not affect calls yet: Vapi picks up immediately, and delaying it between replies would slow down the whole conversation.
callBehavior.maxDurationHint: The call ends automatically when the limit is reached. With no limit, a call ends after 12 hours at the latest.
callBehavior.disclosure: Tell callers about AI and recording
callBehavior.disclosureHint: At the start of the call the agent says the caller is speaking with an AI assistant and that the call may be recorded and transcribed. We recommend keeping this on.
callBehavior.disclosureOff: Warning: if you turn this off, you are responsible for informing callers about the AI and the recording as required by law (GDPR, call recording regulations).

redirect.title: Forwarding conditions
redirect.description: Rules are evaluated from top to bottom and the first matching one is used.
redirect.empty: You have no rules yet. Calls stay with the AI agent.
redirect.messagePlaceholder: Thank you for calling. We cannot take your call right now, please try again later.
